title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Make room for questions
hook: When did a player last ask you a question at practice?
intro: Silence. Then the drill falls apart.
statement: Kids ask questions when it feels safe to not know.
q1: Do you ask players to share one question each —
q2: or keep explanations clear so questions are not needed?
q3: What makes a kid afraid to ask?
t1: Every team is different. But kids learn more
cta: Coaches — how do you invite questions?
ctaLines: Ask a partner first. One question each. Praise good questions.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
When did a player last ask you a question at practice?
You ask, any questions? Silence. Then the drill falls apart.
Kids ask questions when it feels safe to not know.
Invite questions or explain clearly up front. Both can work.
How do you invite questions? Share your habit in the comments.
